description: Crop production: Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) Countries Exposure Data for Disaster Risk Assessment is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by ETH Zürich - Weather and Climate Risks. Historical and twenty-first century crop production in tons. Global gridded (4km resolution) crop yield simulations for maize, rice, soybean, and wheat, encompassing an ensemble of transient yield simulation output from eight global gridded crop models driven by bias-corrected output from five global climate models, as facilitated by the Inter-Sectoral Impact Model Intercomparison Project (ISIMIP, isimip.org). Coverage: Yemen, Syria, Palestine, Afghanistan. The portal files it under the publisher ETH Zürich - Weather and Climate Risks. Its tags are geodata, hazards and risk, humanitarian response plan-hrp, hxl. It offers 24 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-09-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
